purpose: Every 40/64-hex digest and every SHA256: fingerprint written by hand in packaging/signing/** (scripts and documents), with where it comes from. tests/test_signing_procedure_r0prime.py extracts all such tokens and refuses any that is not listed here, and re-verifies each entry against its source when the source is available (R0P_PROVENANCE_SOURCES = the scratch/evidence root; entries whose source is not available are skipped by the test, not assumed). Abbreviated forms in documents (first 8 hex ... last 4 hex) must be a prefix/suffix of a listed value.

entries.meaning: published fingerprint of the existing release key (namespace redevops-qa-release@v1)
entries.source: evidence set final3: SIGNING_REQUEST.md section 3 and VERIFY.md section 6 (the owner publishes the public key at redevops.io/.well-known/redevops-signing-key.txt; `ssh-keygen -lf` on it prints this value); the PUBLIC key itself is committed as packaging/signing/release-signing-key.pub and `ssh-keygen -lf` on it is checked in every test run

entries.meaning: jsign-7.6.jar (GitHub release digest), the pin of the frozen Windows script
SHA-1 of the Microsoft Identity Verification Root CA 2020 (docs/pki/root2020.pem of the frozen set)
entries.source: frozen sign_windows_artifact_signing_v2.sh constant MS_ROOT_SHA1 (also printed in its --help)

entries.meaning: verify_signature_v2.py (the frozen verifier, copied byte-identically into packaging/signing/)
entries.source: recomputed from the file in the repository and from the frozen original
evidence final3 SIGNING_REQUEST.md section 7, recomputed from the frozen file

entries.meaning: sha256 of release-manifest.json of evidence set final3 (the unsigned set named by owner decision 2026-11-04)
